questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 1 一般过去时
questions.text:
— Where did you go on vacation?
— I ___ to the mountains.
questions.explain: did 提示问的是过去，答句也用一般过去时，go 的过去式是 went。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 1 复合不定代词
questions.text: Did you buy ___ special in the shop?
questions.explain: 疑问句和否定句中用 anything；something 一般用于肯定句。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 1 主谓一致
questions.text: Everything ___ fine yesterday.
questions.explain: everything 作主语视为第三人称单数，yesterday 提示过去时，故用 was。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 1 一般过去时
questions.text: I ___ my homework last night.
questions.explain: last night 是过去时间状语，用一般过去时 did。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 1 复合不定代词
questions.text: There was ___ interesting in the newspaper, so I didn't read it.
questions.explain: 后句说“所以我没读”，说明报纸上没有任何有趣的内容，用 nothing 表否定意义。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 1 一般过去时
questions.text: We ___ a great time at the party yesterday.
questions.explain: yesterday 提示过去时，have a great time 的过去式为 had a great time。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 1 主谓一致
questions.text: Nobody ___ the answer. Let's ask the teacher.
questions.explain: nobody 作主语视为第三人称单数，一般现在时用 knows。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 1 助动词后动词形式
questions.text: I didn't ___ anything in the supermarket.
questions.explain: 助动词 didn't 后面必须接动词原形，这是最高频的失分点。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 1 一般疑问句
questions.text: ___ you go to the beach last weekend?
questions.explain: last weekend 是过去时间，实义动词 go 提问需借助 did。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 1 情景交际
questions.text:
— How was your vacation?
— It ___ great!
questions.explain: 问句用 was 询问过去的情况，答句保持时态一致，用 was。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 2 频度副词
questions.text:
— How often do you exercise?
— I exercise ___ a week, every Monday and Friday.
questions.explain: 每周一和周五共两次，用 twice（两次）。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 2 频度副词
questions.text: He ___ goes to bed late. He always sleeps early.
questions.explain: 后句“他总是早睡”说明他从不晚睡，用 never。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 2 频度副词
questions.text: My father is very busy. He ___ has time to watch TV.
questions.explain: hardly ever 意为“几乎不”，符合“很忙、没时间看电视”的语境。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 2 疑问词辨析
questions.text:
— ___ do you go shopping?
— Twice a month.
questions.explain: 答语 Twice a month 表示频率，提问频率用 How often。How long 问时长，How soon 问多久以后。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 2 频度副词
questions.text: She ___ eats junk food because she wants to be healthy.
questions.explain: 因为想保持健康，所以她“很少”吃垃圾食品，seldom 意为很少。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 2 一般现在时
questions.text:
— What do you usually do on weekends?
— I usually ___ TV.
questions.explain: usually 提示一般现在时，主语 I 用动词原形 watch。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 2 频度副词
questions.text: My sister ___ goes to school by bike. She likes walking.
questions.explain: 后句“她喜欢走路”说明她从不骑车上学，用 never。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 2 数量表达
questions.text:
— How many hours do you sleep every night?
— ___ eight hours.
questions.explain: about 意为“大约”，用来修饰数量，符合答语“大约八小时”。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 3 比较级
questions.text: Tom is ___ than his brother.
questions.explain: than 是比较级的标志词，单音节形容词 tall 加 -er 变 taller。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 3 比较级
questions.text: This book is ___ interesting than that one.
questions.explain: interesting 是多音节形容词，比较级用 more interesting，不能加 -er。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 3 比较级
questions.text: My hair is ___ than yours.
questions.explain: than 提示比较级，long 变 longer。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 3 最高级
questions.text: She is the ___ student in her class.
questions.explain: in her class 表示范围，用最高级 the tallest。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 3 最高级
questions.text: This is ___ film I have ever seen.
questions.explain: I have ever seen 表示“我曾经看过的所有电影中”，用最高级且必须加 the。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 3 比较级
questions.text: Li Ming runs ___ than any other student in our class.
questions.explain: than 提示比较级，修饰动词用副词比较级 faster。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 3 比较级
questions.text: Which is ___, the sun or the moon?
questions.explain: 两者（太阳和月亮）比较用比较级，不用最高级。这是高频陷阱。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 3 比较级
questions.text: My English is ___ than before.
questions.explain: good 的比较级是不规则形式 better，than before 提示比较级。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 3 比较级
questions.text: He is ___ outgoing than his sister.
questions.explain: outgoing 是多音节形容词，比较级用 more outgoing。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 3 比较级句型
questions.text: The more you read, ___ you will be.
questions.explain: “the + 比较级, the + 比较级”表示“越……越……”，后半句也要带 the。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 4 最高级
questions.text: This is ___ theater in our city.
questions.explain: in our city 表示范围，用最高级 the best。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 4 最高级
questions.text: Of all the students, he studies ___.
questions.explain: of all 表示范围，用副词最高级。副词最高级前的 the 可以省略，故 hardest 正确。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 4 最高级
questions.text: Which is ___ city in China?
questions.explain: in China 表示范围（三者以上），用最高级且加 the。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 4 最高级
questions.text: This restaurant has ___ service in town.
questions.explain: in town 表示范围，用最高级 the best 修饰 service。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 4 最高级句型
questions.text: Shanghai is one of ___ cities in China.
questions.explain: one of the + 最高级 + 名词复数，表示“最……的之一”，the 不能省。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 4 比较级
questions.text: The radio is ___ than the TV.
questions.explain: than 提示比较级，cheap 变 cheaper。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 4 最高级
questions.text:
— What's ___ movie theater near here?
— Sun Cinema. It has the biggest screens.
questions.explain: 答语用 the biggest 描述，问句也应用最高级 the best。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 4 比较级
questions.text: My hometown is ___ than before.
questions.explain: beautiful 是多音节词，比较级用 more beautiful，than 是标志词。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 5 动名词
questions.text: I don't mind ___ soap operas.
questions.explain: mind 后面接动名词，mind doing sth 意为“介意做某事”。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 5 动名词
questions.text: What do you think of ___ game shows?
questions.explain: of 是介词，介词后面接动名词，故用 watching。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 5 动名词
questions.text: I can't stand ___ soap operas.
questions.explain: can't stand doing sth 意为“无法忍受做某事”，固定搭配动名词。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 5 动词不定式
questions.text: She expects ___ a famous singer.
questions.explain: expect to do sth 意为“期望做某事”，接动词不定式。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 5 动名词
questions.text: Would you mind ___ the window?
questions.explain: Would you mind doing sth? 是请求别人做事的礼貌句型，接动名词。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 5 动词不定式
questions.text: I hope ___ you soon.
questions.explain: hope to do sth 接不定式；注意 hope 不能接 sb to do。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 6 be going to
questions.text: I ___ a doctor when I grow up.
questions.explain: be going to do 表示计划或打算，be 动词是 am，后接 be a doctor。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 6 be going to
questions.text: What ___ you going to do this weekend?
questions.explain: be going to 结构变疑问句时把 be 提前，主语 you 搭配 are。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 6 be going to
questions.text: She ___ visit her grandparents next week.
questions.explain: be going to 不能省略 be，主语 She 搭配 is。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 6 there be 句型
questions.text: There ___ a meeting tomorrow.
questions.explain: there be 句型的将来时是 there is going to be 或 there will be，绝不能用 there have。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 6 疑问词
questions.text:
— ___ are you going to be a writer?
— I'm going to practice writing every day.
questions.explain: 答语说的是方式（每天练习写作），提问方式用 How。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 6 动词短语
questions.text: He is going to ___ a new hobby.
questions.explain: take up 意为“开始从事（某项爱好）”，符合语境。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 7 will
questions.text: People ___ live on the moon in 100 years.
questions.explain: in 100 years 表示将来，用 will + 动词原形。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 7 there be 句型
questions.text: There will ___ less pollution in the future.
questions.explain: there be 的将来时是 there will be，will 后面接动词原形 be，不能用 have。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 7 简略回答
questions.text:
— Will there be more trees?
— Yes, ___.
questions.explain: there be 句型的简略回答用 there will / there won't。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 7 will
questions.text: I think robots ___ help us do housework.
questions.explain: 表示对未来的预测，用 will + 动词原形。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 7 一般将来时疑问句
questions.text: ___ people will have robots in their homes?
questions.explain: 对将来情况提问，把 will 提到句首。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 8 祈使句
questions.text: ___ the bananas and put them in the blender.
questions.explain: 祈使句以动词原形开头，表示指令。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 8 可数与不可数
questions.text: How ___ yogurt do you need?
questions.explain: yogurt 是不可数名词，问数量用 how much。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 8 可数与不可数
questions.text: How ___ bananas do you need?
questions.explain: banana 是可数名词（复数 bananas），问数量用 how many。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 8 否定祈使句
questions.text: ___ turn on the blender before you put in the fruit.
questions.explain: 否定祈使句用 Don't + 动词原形。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 8 名词复数
questions.text: We need two ___ of milk.
questions.explain: two 后面接可数名词复数，cup 的复数是 cups。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 9 情态动词
questions.text:
— Can you come to my party?
— Sorry, I ___. I have to study.
questions.explain: 答语是 Sorry 并说明要学习，说明不能去，用 can't。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 9 情态动词
questions.text: You ___ go out at night. It's dangerous.
questions.explain: mustn't 表示“禁止、不许”，语气最强，符合“晚上出去危险”的警告。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 10 if 条件句
questions.text: If it ___ tomorrow, we will stay at home.
questions.explain: if 引导的条件状语从句遵循“主将从现”：主句用一般将来时，从句用一般现在时，主语 it 用 rains。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 10 if 条件句
questions.text: I will call you if I ___ time.
questions.explain: 主句用 will，从句必须用一般现在时，故填 have。这是最常考的一条。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 10 if 条件句
questions.text: If you ___ hard, you will pass the exam.
questions.explain: 主句 will pass，从句用一般现在时，主语 you 用动词原形 study。

questions.topic: 人教版八上·Unit 10 if 条件句
questions.text: We won't go out if it ___.
questions.explain: 主句 won't go 表将来，从句用一般现在时 rains。

questions.topic: 八上词汇·Unit 1
questions.text: 单词 vacation 的意思是？
questions.explain: vacation 意为假期、休假，on vacation 表示在度假。

questions.topic: 八上词汇·Unit 2
questions.text: 短语 hardly ever 的意思是？
questions.explain: hardly ever 意为几乎不，表示频率极低，接近 never 但不等于 never。

questions.topic: 八上词汇·Unit 3
questions.text: 单词 outgoing 的意思是？
questions.explain: outgoing 意为外向的、爱交际的，是描述性格的高频词，反义词是 quiet/shy。

questions.topic: 八上词汇·Unit 3
questions.text: 单词 talented 的意思是？
questions.explain: talented 意为有才能的、有天赋的，来自名词 talent（天赋）。

questions.topic: 八上词汇·Unit 4
questions.text: 单词 comfortable 的意思是？
questions.explain: comfortable 意为舒适的，常用来形容座位、房间、衣服。

questions.topic: 八上词汇·Unit 4
questions.text: 单词 creative 的意思是？
questions.explain: creative 意为有创造力的，来自动词 create（创造）。

questions.topic: 八上词汇·Unit 7
questions.text: 单词 pollution 的意思是？
questions.explain: pollution 意为污染，是不可数名词，来自动词 pollute。

questions.topic: 八上词汇·Unit 7
questions.text: 单词 astronaut 的意思是？
questions.explain: astronaut 意为宇航员，pilot 才是飞行员，别混。

questions.topic: 八上词汇·Unit 7
questions.text: 单词 dangerous 的意思是？
questions.explain: dangerous 意为危险的，名词是 danger（危险）。

questions.topic: 八上词汇·Unit 8
questions.text: 单词 traditional 的意思是？
questions.explain: traditional 意为传统的，名词是 tradition（传统）。

questions.topic: 八上词汇·Unit 9
questions.text: 单词 available 的意思是？
questions.explain: available 意为可获得的、有空的，Can you come? 的接受回答常说 I'm available。

questions.topic: 八上词汇·Unit 9
questions.text: 单词 disappointed 的意思是？
questions.explain: disappointed 意为失望的，disappointing 意为令人失望的（形容事物）。

questions.topic: 八上词汇·Unit 10
questions.text: 单词 organize 的意思是？
questions.explain: organize 意为组织、筹办，名词是 organization（组织）。

questions.topic: 八上词汇·Unit 10
questions.text: 单词 advice 的意思是？
questions.explain: advice 意为建议，是不可数名词，一条建议说 a piece of advice。

questions.topic: 八上词汇·Unit 10
questions.text: 单词 careless 的意思是？
questions.explain: careless 意为粗心的，care + less（否定后缀）；careful 才是仔细的。

questions.topic: 八上词汇·Unit 10
questions.text: 单词 experience 的意思是？
questions.explain: experience 作不可数名词是经验，作可数名词是经历。

questions.topic: 八上词汇·Unit 7
questions.text: 单词 probably 的意思是？
questions.explain: probably 意为很可能，可能性比 maybe 高，比 certainly 低。

questions.topic: 八上词汇·Unit 2
questions.text: 连词 although 的意思是？
questions.explain: although 意为虽然、尽管，引导让步状语从句，不能和 but 连用。

questions.topic: 八上词汇·Unit 6
questions.text: 单词 improve 的意思是？
questions.explain: improve 意为改进、提高，名词是 improvement。

questions.topic: 八上词汇·Unit 6
questions.text: 单词 promise 的意思是？
questions.explain: promise 意为承诺，常用 make a promise（许下承诺）和 keep a promise（遵守承诺）。

questions.topic: 八上词汇·Unit 5
questions.text: 单词 meaningless 的意思是？
questions.explain: meaningless 意为无意义的，-less 是否定后缀；meaningful 才是有意义的。

questions.topic: 八上词汇·Unit 2
questions.text: 短语 junk food 的意思是？
questions.explain: junk food 意为垃圾食品，是不可数名词。

questions.topic: 八上词汇·Unit 3
questions.text: 单词 competition 的意思是？
questions.explain: competition 意为比赛、竞争，动词是 compete。

questions.topic: 八上词汇·Unit 9
questions.text: 单词 reply 的意思是？
questions.explain: reply 意为回复、答复，reply to 表示回复某人或某物。

questions.topic: 八上词汇·Unit 8
questions.text: 单词 pour 的意思是？
questions.explain: pour 意为倒、灌，做奶昔时 pour the milk into the blender。peel 才是削皮。

questions.topic: 词形变化·care
questions.text: care（关心）的形容词形式是？
questions.explain: care + ful = careful（仔细的、关心的）；加 -less 则是 careless（粗心的）。

questions.topic: 词形变化·care
questions.text: care 的否定形容词（粗心的）是？
questions.explain: -less 表示“没有”，careless 即粗心的。这类后缀题是词汇考查重点。

questions.topic: 固定搭配·be different from
questions.text: My bag is different ___ yours.
questions.explain: be different from 意为与……不同，是固定搭配，介词必须是 from。

questions.topic: 固定搭配·be good at
questions.text: He is good ___ playing basketball.
questions.explain: be good at 意为擅长，at 是介词，后面接动名词 playing。

questions.topic: 同义替换
questions.text: hardly ever 最接近的意思是？
questions.explain: hardly ever 意为几乎不，最接近 almost never，这是同义替换高频考点。

questions.topic: 同义替换
questions.text: be similar to 的意思是？
questions.explain: be similar to 意为与……相似，最接近 be like。

questions.topic: 固定搭配·look forward to
questions.text: I look forward to ___ you soon.
questions.explain: look forward to 中的 to 是介词，后面必须接动名词，这是最容易错的一题。

questions.topic: 固定搭配·decide to do
questions.text: She decided ___ a doctor.
questions.explain: decide to do sth 意为决定做某事，接动词不定式。

questions.topic: 固定搭配·be afraid of
questions.text: The little girl is afraid ___ dogs.
questions.explain: be afraid of sth 意为害怕某物；be afraid to do 则是害怕做某事。

questions.topic: 固定搭配·agree with
questions.text: I agree ___ you on this point.
questions.explain: agree with sb 意为同意某人；agree to 后接计划或建议。

questions.topic: 形容词辨析·-ed 与 -ing
questions.text: The movie is so ___ that I fell asleep.
questions.explain: -ing 形容词表示“令人……的”，修饰事物；-ed 形容词表示“感到……的”，修饰人。电影令人困倦，用 boring。

questions.topic: 形容词辨析·-ed 与 -ing
questions.text: I am ___ in this book.
questions.explain: be interested in 意为对……感兴趣，人作主语用 -ed 形式。

questions.topic: 名词复数
questions.text: tomato 的复数形式是？
questions.explain: 以 o 结尾的部分名词加 -es，如 tomato→tomatoes、potato→potatoes。

questions.topic: 名词复数
questions.text: child 的复数形式是？
questions.explain: child 是不规则复数，复数为 children，不能再加 s。

questions.topic: 可数与不可数
questions.text: 下列名词中属于不可数名词的是？
questions.explain: water 是不可数名词，不能直接加 s，要用 a glass of water 这类量词表达。

questions.topic: 语法·一般现在时三单
questions.text: He ___ to school by bus every day.
questions.explain: every day 提示一般现在时，主语 He 是第三人称单数，动词加 -es。

questions.topic: 语法·现在进行时
questions.text: Look! The children ___ football on the playground.
questions.explain: Look! 提示动作正在发生，用现在进行时 be + doing，主语复数用 are。

questions.topic: 语法·一般过去时
questions.text: She ___ TV last night.
questions.explain: last night 是过去时间状语，用一般过去时 watched。

questions.topic: 语法·现在进行时否定
questions.text: He ___ sleeping. He is reading.
questions.explain: 现在进行时的否定是 be + not + doing，主语 He 用 isn't。

questions.topic: 语法·一般过去时疑问句
questions.text: ___ you see him yesterday?
questions.explain: yesterday 提示过去时，实义动词 see 提问需用助动词 Did。

questions.topic: 语法·冠词
questions.text: I have ___ apple and ___ banana.
questions.explain: apple 以元音音素开头用 an，banana 以辅音音素开头用 a。

questions.topic: 语法·冠词
questions.text: He plays ___ piano very well.
questions.explain: 演奏乐器前要加定冠词 the，如 play the piano；但球类运动前不加，如 play basketball。

questions.topic: 语法·介词
questions.text: I was born ___ 2009.
questions.explain: 年份、月份、季节前用 in；具体某天用 on；具体时刻用 at。

questions.topic: 语法·介词
questions.text: My birthday is ___ May 5th.
questions.explain: 具体到某一天（含日期）用 on，这是 in/on/at 的经典辨析。

questions.topic: 语法·介词
questions.text: We will have a party ___ 7 o'clock.
questions.explain: 具体时刻前用 at，如 at 7 o'clock。

questions.topic: 语法·物主代词
questions.text: This is ___ book. （我的）
questions.explain: 修饰名词要用形容词性物主代词 my；mine 是名词性物主代词，后面不能接名词。

questions.topic: 语法·物主代词
questions.text: The book is ___. （我的）
questions.explain: 句末单独使用、后面不接名词时，用名词性物主代词 mine。

questions.topic: 语法·反身代词
questions.text: He hurt ___ when he fell off the bike.
questions.explain: 主语和宾语是同一人时用反身代词，he 对应 himself。

questions.topic: 语法·连词
questions.text: ___ it was raining, we still went out.
questions.explain: 前后是让步关系（虽然下雨，还是出去了），用 Although。注意 Although 不能与 but 连用。

questions.topic: 语法·连词
questions.text: It was raining, ___ we stayed at home.
questions.explain: 前因后果，用 so 连接结果；because 引导原因，语序相反。

questions.topic: 语法·不定代词
questions.text: ___ of the students has a dictionary.
questions.explain: 谓语是 has（单数），说明主语视为单数，Each of 符合；All/Both/Some of 后接复数谓语 have。

questions.topic: 语法·频率副词位置
questions.text: He ___ late for school.
questions.explain: 频率副词放在 be 动词之后、实义动词之前，故 is never 正确。

questions.topic: 语法·频率副词位置
questions.text: She ___ goes shopping on Sundays.
questions.explain: 频率副词放在实义动词 goes 之前，直接用 often goes。

questions.topic: 语法·比较级
questions.text: This bag is ___ than that one.
questions.explain: heavy 是辅音字母+y 结尾，变比较级要改 y 为 i 再加 -er，即 heavier。

questions.topic: 语法·最高级
questions.text: He is ___ boy in his class.
questions.explain: in his class 表示范围，用最高级且必须加 the。
